name: folk
description: folk is a CRM built for relationship-driven teams. With the folk MCP server, Claude can search your contacts, companies, and deals, add notes and interactions, analyze your pipeline to surface who to follow up with, and create or update records — without leaving your workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add folk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add folk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.folk.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the folk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: folk lists 14 MCP tools, including folk_create_company, folk_create_object, folk_create_person, folk_get_company, folk_get_current_user, folk_get_object, folk_get_person, folk_get_workspace_structure, folk_search_companies, folk_search_objects, folk_search_people, and folk_update_company.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to folk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to folk in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
folk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
folk is developed by folk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
